ENVIRONMENT: AdGuard for Windows is running and proxies every loopback HTTP connection from python.exe. The :8800 media protocol keeps sending multipart bytes after the HTTP 200, and AdGuard answers them with its own '400 Bad request' page. Real-TCP :8800 tests therefore cannot pass on this machine. HTTPS, ONVIF, RTSP and ffmpeg are not affected. Added fixtures loopback_http_stream_ok (session bool) and require_loopback_http_stream (skips with a reason). The self-check runs every :8800 test over an in-memory socket pair (raw_clients.mem_socketpair, which drives the real server handler) and over TCP; the 6 TCP variants are the skips. Media-lane :8800 integration tests need require_loopback_http_stream, or python.exe excluded from AdGuard filtering.
Windows loopback: connecting to a closed port takes about 2 s before ConnectionRefusedError, so tests that probe refused ports need a connect timeout of at least 3 s.

request_log holds every flattened sub-request {method, params} of each multipleRequest, plus single inner requests. raw_request_log keeps the whole decrypted inner bodies. login_count counts successful logins; login_attempts counts every login POST.

Secure /ds errors: unknown or expired stok, missing or bad tapo_tag, missing seq, or seq below the next expected value (replay) -> HTTP 200 {error_code:-40401}. seq may skip ahead (lost requests) but must never go backwards. A bad securePassthrough payload or non-JSON body -> -40210. Step-2 wrong digest_passwd -> -40401. A reused or unknown step-2 cnonce gets a fresh -40413 challenge. A legacy camera answers secure step 1 with -40210 (no -40413). lock_login -> -40404 with result.data.sec_left.

Dispatcher error codes: unknown method -40106; missing module/section/field or a selector that does not name the section -40211; wrong type or value outside the documented enum -40210 (e.g. motorMove x_coord must be a string); PTZ boundary -64304; preset limit (8) -64306. rebootDevice and inject_token_expiry both invalidate the session, so the client must re-login.

Shadow units: ptz_x in [-180,180], ptz_y in [-90,90]; singalMove steps by 10; ONVIF ContinuousMove adds round(velocity*10). presets is {id: {name, x, y, read_only}}, seeded with '1' Door and '2' Gate. Recordings: 3 clips today UTC (01:00 60 s motion, 02:00 120 s timing, 03:00 30 s person) and 1 clip yesterday (12:00 60 s). Search clips are matched on their UTC start.

The :8800 server issues a Digest challenge with qop=auth and algorithm=cam.media_digest_algorithm ('MD5' default, 'SHA-256' optional), plus encrypt_type=3 iff secure (password' = SHA256U(cloud), else MD5U). Key-Exchange is sent only when the client sends X-Key-Exchange: 1. Download/playback stream the cached 6 s MPEG-TS (H.264 640x360 + AAC; ffmpeg cannot mux PCMA into TS) in 6016-byte AES parts, whatever the clip length, then stream_status finished. Flow control: at most media_ack_window=50 un-acked parts; with no ack for media_ack_timeout=5 s the server sends connection_closed and closes. A 3rd authenticated session -> HTTP 503 {error_code:-52407}. An unknown clip -> response error_code -52402.

RTSP: RTP/AVP/TCP interleaved, H.264 PT96 (single NAL + FU-A, MTU 1400) and PCMA PT8 in 20 ms packets, real-time pacing at 15 fps, continuous timestamps across loops, PLAY replied before the first RTP packet. No RTCP SR is sent. The max_rtsp_clients slot is held from the first SETUP until TEARDOWN or disconnect; DESCRIBE/SETUP return 453 beyond it. set_rtsp_corrupt_audio sends valid RTP headers with garbled payloads of random length (1-159 bytes) and drops every 7th packet. Truncated RTP headers were tried first, but they made ffmpeg stall for more than 10 s, so they were left out.

ONVIF: GetSystemDateAndTime is the only operation allowed without auth. Only PasswordDigest is accepted (PasswordText -> NotAuthorized). Subscription managers live at /onvif/subscription/<id>; requests posted to /onvif/service are routed by wsa:To, or to the only live subscription. Motion events emitted before any subscription exists go to the first subscription created. ws_discovery_responder(probe=None) returns ProbeMatches bytes, or b'' when probe is not a Probe.

Extra non-contract knobs on MockTapoCamera: fixed_nonce/fixed_start_seq (reproduce auth.golden_vector.v3 exactly; the self-check posts the golden outer body and tag and is accepted), media_digest_algorithm, media_ack_window/timeout, media_chunk_size, max_media_sessions, max_failed_logins/lockout_seconds (auto lockout, off by default), media_acks, media_request_log, media_active_sessions, onvif_op_log. The cert is self-signed EC P-256, regenerated per camera.

Media assets come from ffmpeg (libx264 baseline, keyframe every 15 frames, repeat-headers) and are cached in %TEMP%/tapo_mock_cache (override with env TAPO_MOCK_CACHE). The first generation takes about 1 s. Without ffmpeg the HTTPS/ONVIF surfaces still work; RTSP DESCRIBE returns 500.
conftest also skips tests marked hardware unless TAPO_HW_IP is set, and provides ffprobe_path.
